basis: German collected-edition reprint, all eight pages visually inspected; independent English. Original journal impression not separately collated.
ocrWarning: Raw OCR only: formulas and letters are unreliable. The linked scan pages, all visually inspected, are authoritative; OCR is supplied for tracing, not quoted as accurate German transcription.
coverage: Introduction, five numbered sections, all five author footnotes. Contact classification announcements and global claims are retained with explicit qualifications.

authorFootnotes.content: Analogue of the bracket condition in two variables.
Point transformations in three variables preserving the contact equation.
Preservation of the differential equation means preservation of its integral curves.
Reference to the sphere and line-complex paper in Mathematische Annalen V.
Infinitesimal contact symmetry and an integrating factor; joint paper with Klein.

editorialQualifications: Closure alone does not ensure identity or inverses.
The regular analytic local hypothesis and nonvanishing generators are explicit.
Contact equation ratios are rewritten without division; the covector/slope sign is supplied.
Coupled actions on two curve families need not be a direct product.
The higher-dimensional bounded-types and linear-realization claims are not proved here.
The integrating factor needs a transverse symmetry.
The contact classification is announced without proof.
proofStatus: Five written reconstructions, without proof-assistant verification. Six editorial drawings.
englishSources: No existing English is used for the 1874 rendering. Ackerman 1975 concerns 1880; Merker concerns Lie and Engel 1888.
